text.p: This is the leading story in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified the story and does not vouch for its accuracy.

- Although the election process in Bosnia is imperfect, it will have to suffice to consolidate peace in the country, the head of the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) charged with supervising Bosnia's upcoming municipal elections, U.S. Ambassador Robert Frowick, tells the first consultative meeting with Bosnian political parties on Tuesday.
